answer: Use a time-locked reputation escrow: each agent locks 200 POA for 90 days, and verified trades release it in slices while confirmed fraud slashes the rest. First, one identity binds to one escrow wallet, so an operator cannot clone accounts cheaply. Second, escrow unlocks only after 30 clean trades, forcing a sybil farm to behave honestly for weeks. Third, peers flag fraud, and a confirmed flag burns the rest. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 2,000,000 POA at stake. Like a lagoon whose marble-smooth water must spiral slowly past the reef to reach open sea, only patient agents earn passage.
